record.paper_title: Whitehead's Asphericity Question and Its Relation to Other Open Problems
record.original_question: If X is a finite 3-complex whose cohomological dimension is at most 2, is X homotopy equivalent to a 2-complex?

evidence.quote: finite 3-complex X with cdX ≤ 2 is homotopy equivalent to a 2-complex

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $X$ be a finite connected CW complex of dimension $3$. Suppose that the cohomological dimension of $X$ is at most $2$, meaning that $H^n(X;\mathcal{B}) = 0$ for all $n \geq 3$ and for every local coefficient system $\mathcal{B}$ on $X$ (equivalently, for every $\mathbb{Z}[\pi_1(X)]$-module $\mathcal{B}$). Must $X$ be homotopy equivalent to a finite CW complex of dimension at most $2$?
artifact.status_search_result: Wall's D(2) problem remains open in general. Positive results are known for various classes of fundamental groups (e.g., finite subgroups of SO(3) and certain other finite groups), and recent work (e.g., 2023 papers on Quillen's plus construction and generalized Swan modules) continues to study it, indicating no complete general resolution to date.

status_evidence.title: Quillen's Plus Construction and the D(2) problem
status_evidence.snippet: Reduces the D(2) problem to a question about perfect normal subgroups via the Quillen plus construction applied to Cayley complexes of finite group presentations.
status_evidence.claim: D(2) problem still being actively reformulated/studied as of 2023, indicating it remains open.

status_evidence.title: Stable modules and Wall's D(2)-problem
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Wall's D(2)-problem via stable modules, establishing it for various finite fundamental groups.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results for specific fundamental groups have been established.

status_evidence.title: Two remarks on Wall's D2 problem
status_evidence.snippet: Continued investigation of Wall's D(2) problem.
status_evidence.claim: Problem remains an active research topic without a general solution.
